location: Melbourne (Mulgrave VIC) with FIFO site year
subject: Engineering Graduate Program application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Austral Engineering Graduate Program. Your program page asks interested graduates to contact careers@australconstruction.com.au. My preferred office is Melbourne (Mulgrave).

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site, regional and FIFO work.

Your two-year path with an office year in tendering, planning and design then a FIFO site year is the contractor graduate structure I am seeking. I do not yet have Australian construction contractor employment, so I am looking for mentoring on live project delivery.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
